title: negretia nigricans
intro: Negretia nigricans, commonly known as Blackseed Negretia, is a plant species in the family Asteraceae. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of Negretia nigricans include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as wound healing, antiseptic, and anti-inflammatory effects. The plant is used to treat various conditions, including skin infections, wounds, and respiratory issues, making it a valuable resource in traditional medicine.
